name: Amanat Acquisition Corp Class A Ordinary Shares
summary: Amanat Acquisition Corp. operates as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), formed with the explicit goal of executing a business combination, which may involve a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, or reorganization, with one or more existing enterprises or organizations. The company, headquartered in Westfield, NJ, commenced operations on January 13, 2026.
